notes: The supplied text (pages 630-633) contains only the program list and the A.A. degree sections (Administrative, Advocacy and Social Policy, Case Management and Social Services). The certificate 'Gerontology: Advocacy and Social Policy Certificate' appears only as a title in the program list on page 630; its requirements, outcomes and career information are not in the text, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers were recorded.

The A.A. in Gerontology: Advocacy and Social Policy (pages 631-632) lists 36 total units: COMM C1004; COMM 325 or SWCD 330 or PSYC 365; GERON 303; GERON 305 or PSYC 375; GERON 306; GERON 490; SWCD 300; SWCD 310; a minimum of 3 units of GERON 498; and a minimum of 9 units from COMM C1000/COMM 302/COMM 311, POLS C1000/POLS 304/POLS 330, SJS 300/SOC 300. The certificate likely shares these requirements; a reviewer should fetch the certificate section (later in the catalog) to confirm.
Closed list uses older codes (HSER 300/310/330, COMM 321) where the catalog prints SWCD 300/310/330 and COMM C1004.
